arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

API=https://slack.com/api
TOKEN="***"

# Find kudos channel
chan_id=$(curl -s -G "$API/conversations.list" --data-urlencode "types=public_channel" \
  -d "token=$TOKEN" | jq -r '.channels[] | select(.name=="kudos") | .id')

if [[ -z "$chan_id" || "$chan_id" == "null" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: kudos channel not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "chan=$chan_id" >&2

# Fetch all messages (paginate), collect ts + reaction counts
: > /tmp/slack_kudos_msgs.tsv
cursor=""
oldest=""
while :; do
  params=(-d "token=$TOKEN" -d "channel=$chan_id" -d "limit=500" -d "inclusive=true")
  [[ -n "$oldest" ]] && params+=(-d "latest=$oldest")
  resp=$(curl -s -G "$API/conversations.history" "${params[@]}")
  count=$(echo "$resp" | jq '.messages | length')
  if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then break; fi
  echo "$resp" | jq -r '.messages[] | [.ts, (.reactions // [] | map(.count) | add // 0)] | @tsv' >> /tmp/slack_kudos_msgs.tsv
  new_oldest=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.messages[-1].ts')
  if [[ "$new_oldest" == "$oldest" || "$count" -lt 500 ]]; then break; fi
  oldest="$new_oldest"
done

echo "total messages: $(wc -l < /tmp/slack_kudos_msgs.tsv)" >&2

# Message with the most reactions (ties: most recent)
read -r winner_ts winner_count < <(sort -t$'\t' -k2,2nr -k1,1nr /tmp/slack_kudos_msgs.tsv | head -1)
echo "winner ts=$winner_ts count=$winner_count" >&2

# Add :fire: reaction
curl -s -G "$API/reactions.add" \
  --data-urlencode "name=fire" \
  -d "token=$TOKEN" \
  -d "channel=$chan_id" \
  -d "timestamp=$winner_ts"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
API=https://slack.com/api
TOKEN="***"
chan_id=$(curl -s -G "$API/conversations.list" --data-urlencode "types=public_channel" \
  -d "token=$TOKEN" | jq -r '.channels[] | select(.name=="kudos") | .id')
echo "chan=$chan_id" >&2

# All message ts in channel (paginate)
ts_list=""
oldest=""
while :; do
  params=(-G "$API/conversations.history" -d "token=$TOKEN" -d "channel=$chan_id" -d "limit=500" -d "inclusive=true")
  [[ -n "$oldest" ]] && params+=(-d "latest=$oldest")
  resp=$(curl -s "${params[@]}")
  count=$(echo "$resp" | jq '.messages | length')
  [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]] && break
  echo "$resp" | jq -r '.messages[] | .ts' >> /tmp/ts_list.txt
  new_oldest=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.messages[-1].ts')
  if [[ "$new_oldest" == "$oldest" || "$count" -lt 500 ]]; then break; fi
  oldest="$new_oldest"
done

: > /tmp/reaction_counts.tsv
while IFS= read -r ts; do
  out=$(curl -s -G "$API/reactions.get" \
    -d "token=$TOKEN" -d "channel=$chan_id" -d "timestamp=$ts")
  total=$(echo "$out" | jq '[.message.reactions // [] | map(.count)] | add // 0')
  detail=$(echo "$out" | jq -c '[.message.reactions // [] | map({name,count})]')
  echo -e "$ts\t$total\t$detail" >> /tmp/reaction_counts.tsv
done < /tmp/ts_list.txt

echo "=== ts / total / detail ===" >&2
sort -t$'\t' -k2,2nr /tmp/reaction_counts.tsv
